criteria.text: Attachment picker should not gate on file type. Let the user attach any file; move type validation (if any) to the point of consumption, not the file picker (`ACCEPTED_FILE_TYPES` / `ACCEPTED_FILE_EXTENSIONS` in `file-picker.ts`, and wherever the Flutter desktop client mirrors this list).
criteria.test_id: issue-1137-c1: REAL-SURFACE composer attaches an arbitrary binary @-mention as a file: ref without a type gate
supporting_tests: apps/opencode_fork/packages/app/src/components/prompt-input/attachments.test.ts :: createPromptAttachments consumes an arbitrary binary after selection
apps/desktop_flutter/test/features/agents/ocu_1061_at_mention_test.dart :: native picker arbitrary binary and read-error surface

criteria.text: Longer-term: when an agent receives an attached file it has no reader for, the agentic procedure should be to search for / surface an existing MCP tool, skill, or server capable of reading that file type (similar to how the Office-document skill was added) rather than silently failing or ignoring the attachment.
criteria.test_id: issue-1137-c2: unreadable arbitrary binary becomes an actionable reader-discovery task
supporting_tests: apps/opencode_fork/packages/opencode/test/session/prompt.test.ts :: browser binary materializes and surfaces the exact installed reader ahead of six noisy generic Rhythm matches
apps/api_server/src/__tests__/live_e2e_1137_any_file_reader_discovery.test.ts :: native/browser live binary + surfaced reader + symlink rejection

criteria.text: The actual native/path attachment producer must flow through buildRequestParts into prompt reader discovery for an unknown binary format without a test handcrafting the MIME.
criteria.test_id: issue-1137-c3: native path producer shape reaches reader discovery without a handcrafted MIME

criteria.text: A binary byte occurring beyond the first 4 KiB must classify the attachment as binary in browser and Flutter desktop attachment paths.
criteria.test_id: issue-1137-c4: delayed binary bytes beyond the 4 KiB prefix remain binary

criteria.text: The live behavioral gate must assert native-path and browser-data attachment reader discovery independently, with traversal/symlink rejection occurring before either prompt.
criteria.test_id: native and browser attachment legs each persist their own reader-discovery evidence

criteria.text: Browser data attachment materialization must create a private 0600 temporary file and remove it with the session.
criteria.test_id: issue-1137-c6: materialized browser attachment is private and session-scoped

criteria.text: Reader discovery must hide permission-denied skill and MCP candidates while surfacing an exact allowlisted MCP reader candidate.
criteria.test_id: issue-1137-c7: discovery respects session allowlists and surfaces the exact MCP reader

criteria.text: The mobile gateway must not expose the desktop-local /agent-sessions file-content response or its absolute resolvedPath field.
criteria.test_id: issue-1137-c8: mobile gateway cannot route agent-sessions file content or resolvedPath

criteria.text: Mobile prompt and prompt_async file parts must be validated before engine forwarding: only real file paths contained by the server-resolved registered project (including symlink containment) and valid browser data URLs are accepted.
criteria.test_id: issue-1137-c9: prompt file parts are canonicalized or rejected before forwarding
supporting_tests: apps/api_server/src/__tests__/issue_1169_mobile_opencode_proxy.test.ts :: HTTP rejects an outside prompt file before the engine boundary
apps/api_server/src/__tests__/issue_1169_mobile_opencode_proxy_live.test.ts :: real engine receives contained file and data URLs only after outside and symlink attempts leave the session empty

criteria.text: Every non-image/non-PDF browser attachment must be classified from its complete bytes with fatal UTF-8 decoding and control-byte checks, even when the browser declares a text MIME.
criteria.test_id: issue-1137-c10: delayed binary bytes override empty text and misleading MIME declarations

criteria.text: A valid minimal DOCX attached through the live API and real fork engine must be read using the existing document skill/reader, with the known document marker appearing in the assistant result.
criteria.test_id: extracts a known marker from a valid DOCX through the existing document reader
